hypothesis: Separate conservative transport from condensation after the first rainout pilot failed; test the existing wide conservative operator, short conservative hops with effectively unlimited capacity, and one weaker crest limit.
pilot_requirements: Mean rainfall loss and monthly rainfall MAE must improve; mean temperature MAE must not worsen by more than 1%; no regional monthly rainfall MAE increase greater than max(2 mm, 10%); select at most one combination for dev31, by lowest mean rainfall loss.
diagnostics: Confirm actual condensation is zero in the effectively unlimited-capacity run. Compare its results with wide conservative exchange and the 0.5 setting to attribute the failed first pilot; these are reused development regions, not independent confirmation.
development_gate: Unchanged policy_v2: S improves at least 0.5%, no group worsens, neither temperature MAE nor rainfall loss worsens by more than 1%.
transfer: Only after dev31 passes, paired 28 km California, western Europe, Japan and New Zealand, then the six established validation regions once. Those regions were evaluated previously, not fresh validation.
publication: No adoption from a pilot gain. Preserve r31 and the published atlases unless the complete development, transfer and native atlas verification sequence passes.
